name_de: Cube Reaction Hybrid Performance 720 FE Easy Entry
name_en: Cube Reaction Hybrid Performance 720 FE Easy Entry
description_de: Das Cube Reaction Hybrid Performance 720 FE Easy Entry ist ein E-Hardtail-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line) mit bis zu 75 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 720-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: SR Suntour X32 NLO Coil, Tapered, 15x110mm, 100mm. Schaltung: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano BR-MT200, Hydr. Disc Brake (180/180). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Reaction Hybrid Performance 720 FE Easy Entry is an electric hardtail mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line) with up to 75 Nm of torque is powered by a 720 Wh battery. Suspension: SR Suntour X32 NLO Coil, Tapered, 15x110mm, 100mm. Drivetrain: Shimano Deore RD-M6200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano BR-MT200, Hydr. Disc Brake (180/180). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
